name: chat
title: Chat with sources
shows: An assistant window: a customer's question, then an answer written word by word with the two sources it used (a real app icon and a help article) the customer's thanks and an input.
place: at-rise to-edge fit with --fit-max: 400px, 32 to 56px down, with .stage--fade-b: the body fills the wrapper, so the input always sits past the bottom edge, whatever the panel's height; the answer and its sources stay clear of the fade
edit: Write the product's own question and answer; keep the answer to three lines and name real sources (a small mark beside the source's name stays in the ink, like the text it sits in).
loop: about 2.7 s a cycle: typing dots for 0.8 s, the answer's last sentence written again in place in under 0.8 s (never below 72% ink), its sources back one by one; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
